text:
alex: Quick async micro-standup for SDKs/quickstarts/sampleapp.
- What I did: finished the Node quickstart rewrite, trimmed examples to a minimal end-to-end flow, and bumped the SDK example to use `@redwood/inference@0.8.2`.
- Blockers: sampleapp integration tests failing on macos runners (flaky native deps). CI logs point to `ld: symbol(s) not found` in the native tokenizer binary.
- Today: will add a non-native JS fallback and open a PR for the quickstart; pinging reviewers early.

mina: Thanks — awesome. Re: native tokenizer, can you try `npm rebuild` in the CI job or add `--build-from-source` for that package? I've seen that fix this exact error on mac runners. Also I can help with the JS fallback shim.

alex: Good call, will add `npm rebuild` to the macos job and a feature-flag in the quickstart to choose `tokenizer.native` or `tokenizer.js`.

oliver: Mini note — sampleapp still uses the old streaming example. If you change the SDK usage, update the README code snippet here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/blob/main/README.md#streaming

alex: ack, adding that to the PR checklist. Also adding a short note about `REDWOOD_API_KEY` env var and a one-liner for local mock: `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=test && npm run dev`.

marco: FYI I'll do a doc sweep later today to catch any mismatched param names in the quickstart (e.g., we recently renamed `model` -> `model_id`). If you need immediate review ping @marco.

ci-bot: build #4821 (sampleapp/macos) failed — see https://ci.redwood.dev/build/4821. Tests failed: 3, Duration: 12m. @alex @mina

alex: Thanks CI. Re-ran locally with `npm rebuild` and the tests pass. Pushing the CI change now.

mina: small ask — can we add an assertion to the quickstart test for the streaming output shape? It prevents silent regressions. Something like:
```
expect(response.tokens[0]).toHaveProperty('text')
expect(response.tokens.length).toBeGreaterThan(2)
```

alex: Yep will include that. Plan: open PR in ~30m, include macos CI tweak + JS fallback + README snippet updates + test assertion. Tagging @oliver @marco for quick review, and @devex for visibility :eyes:

oliver: will review once CI passes, should be quick. :thumbsup:

marco: available in ~1hr for docs review. :ok_hand:

alex: thanks team — will update this thread when PR is up.

ci-bot: PR #1289 opened by alex: "quickstart: macos ci fix, js fallback, README sync" https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1289 :rocket:

alex: PR link posted, leaving it open for reviewers. If anyone spots anything obvious please leave inline comments — focusing on keeping the quickstart <5min to try for new users.
